audience: freelancers and small companies that keep their books in billey and want an AI assistant to read them

useCases.title: Review invoices and their line items
useCases.text: List invoices with their status and dates. Open one invoice for its client summary and line items.

useCases.title: Review expenses and their vendors
useCases.text: List expenses with amounts, dates, the vendor summary and the account. Read the vendors for their contact and payment details.

useCases.title: Find bank transactions to match
useCases.text: List imported bank transactions with amount, counterparty and match state.

useCases.title: Check the hours logged on a project
useCases.text: List the projects, then list the time entries with their hours, hourly rate and date.

useCases.title: Sync client changes into another tool
useCases.text: List clients in pages, and use updated_after to read only changes. Open one client for its contact and payment details.
